threads.body: This drops the previous `model_dump()`/`__dict__` normalization. For tool arguments containing objects such as Pydantic models, the shared JSON serializer can fail and fall back to a string representation of the entire dictionary, so `gen_ai.tool.call.arguments` is no longer valid JSON. Could we preserve the previous normalization?
